lead_independence.lead: When investigators searched 77-year-old Gail Gustino's home near Hobe Sound on July 20, they found 92 dogs and cats living in triple-digit heat with no ventilation and surrounded by inches of waste. Gustino has since been released from jail on bond, with her next court date scheduled for September. Since the initial rescue, the Humane Society of the Treasure Coast says the total number of animals recovered has climbed to 108, with more arriving daily.

lead_independence.headline: Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office communications officer killed in Port St. Lucie murder-suicide
lead_independence.lead: The Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office identified the victim as Elizabeth Ortega, a communications officer who served in emergency communications for nearly 25 years. Ortega began her emergency communications career with the Greenacres Police Department in November 2001 and joined the Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office Emergency Communications Division following the agencies' merger in February 2016. Our Communications Division is deeply saddened to announce the sudden and tragic passing of Communications Officer Elizabeth 'Liz' Ortega, the sheriff's office said. She was a respected and cherished part of our PBSO family, known for her kindness, compassion, and a warm smile that could brighten any room.

lead_independence.lead: Michael Jeffrey Spiers, 36, from Fort Myers was arrested after a road rage incident Saturday night on I-95 in Martin County that caused a family's SUV to crash into a barbed-wire fence near Kanner Highway and 96th Street around 7:30 p.m. The family from North Carolina ran out of the car and into the brush to hide until deputies arrived. Spiers is charged with aggravated battery with a deadly weapon and child abuse.
